title: Voltage and Transformers
subtitle: LV, MV and HV
text:
Cables come in three voltages and only join their own kind.

LV, Redstone Copper Cable (red): 1,000 FE/t.
MV, Gold Cable (yellow): 8,000 FE/t.
HV, Diamond Cable (light blue): 64,000 FE/t.

Every machine, generator and battery is LV. A Transformer links two voltages: the front, the side facing you when you place it, is the higher one and every other face the lower. FE goes both ways, losing 5%. The LV/MV one moves up to 1,000 FE/t each way, the MV/HV one 8,000.

Overvoltage: feed MV or HV into a lower rated cable end, machine or transformer face and it explodes. Server owners can turn off the terrain damage in config/simplemachines-server.properties.
